description: This file declares functions related to graph fusion passes in the Torch JIT compiler, including functionality to fuse nodes in a computational graph for optimization purposes.

methods.name: canFuseOnCPULegacy
methods.description: Checks if CPU fusion is supported in legacy mode.

methods.name: overrideCanFuseOnCPULegacy
methods.description: Overrides the support status for CPU fusion in legacy mode.

methods.name: FuseGraph
methods.description: Performs graph fusion on the provided computational graph.

methods.name: CustomFuseGraph
methods.description: Performs custom fusion on the graph using a node-level callback to determine fusibility.
